description: This file is a Makefile used for building OpenWrt/LEDE firmware, containing build rules, variable definitions, and include directives.

methods.name: shvar
methods.description: Slugifies variable names by replacing dots, hyphens, and slashes with underscores.

methods.name: shexport
methods.description: Creates and exports a variable with the name derived from a function, setting it to the function's result.

methods.name: YEAR_2038
methods.description: Detects support for 64-bit time in C using a small test program.

methods.name: locked
methods.description: Executes a shell command under a file lock if 'flock' is available.

methods.name: file_copy
methods.description: Recursively copies files from a glob pattern into a destination directory, removing dangling symlinks beforehand.

methods.name: sha256sums
methods.description: Calculates sha256 checksums for files within a directory, optionally recursing into subdirectories.

methods.name: commitcount
methods.description: Counts Git commits since last update or bump message, or generates a date-based string if Git is unavailable.
